name: Masahiro Suzuki
intro: I am a postdoctoral researcher at Chalmers University of Technology studying how climate policies and energy transitions evolve together, and whether historical rates of change are consistent with the pace required to meet climate goals. I completed my PhD in Environmental Sciences and Policy at Central European University in 2024, focusing on political acceleration in energy transitions. Before my PhD, I worked on climate-policy research and participated in international climate negotiations as a national delegate of Japan.
